# Ray Cast Hit Player

Source: [wiki article 4729](../archive/4729.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Ray Cast Hit Player](../../api/values/ray-cast-hit-player.md).

<a id="wiki-4729-n1"></a>

- No player hit returns Null; raycasts ignore Phased Out players.

<a id="wiki-4729-n2"></a>

- Player position arguments resolve two meters above feet; excluded players take precedence over included players.

<a id="wiki-4729-n3"></a>

- Player-owned objects toggle includes barriers/turrets.
